Maya: FYI hit a rare crash in page-coordinator during a noisy multi-tenant loadtest (heavy pin/unpin churn + async offload). attaching minimal repro and logs.
Aj: paste stack and repro please?
Maya: gist below. looks like an invalid mapping after eviction+remap race.
Maya: ```
[2026-03-19T21:17:12Z] page-coord: claim failed: page=0x7f3b2c00 tid=2378 state=RESIDENT
[2026-03-19T21:17:12Z] eviction: kick for tenant=42 slab=staging pool=HOST
[2026-03-19T21:17:12Z] remap: remapping vaddr=0x7f3b2c00 -> hostpage=0x55f4c000
[2026-03-19T21:17:12Z] fault: invalid mapping accessed by kernel
panic: double-unmap detected
```
(repro: loop pin/unpin 100k across 8 workers w/ batching and prefetch=on)
Sasha: smells like lifetime mismatch between eviction token and allocator pin. pin() might succeed while eviction clears metadata.
Liam: seen similar in segmented allocator where evict() races with claim() -> lost CAS on page descriptor.
Aj: any telemetry on pin-latency vs evict bursts? timing-specific?
Maya: telemetry shows pin_latency <1ms then eviction bursts right after; likely prefetch+async offload overlap.
Sasha: mitigation idea: epoch handshake on pins, pin(handle, epoch) refuses if epoch < allocator_epoch; eviction advances epoch to prevent new pins.
Liam: that works but is API/ABI churn. Alternative: evict() takes exclusive stamp per-page before removing mapping but hurts hot-path throughput.
Aj: hybrid: optimistic fast-path pin, then validate epoch/evict-flag before returning. on detection, undo and go to slow-path which blocks on evict_quiesce().
Maya: slow-path should be rare; sounds acceptable.
Sasha: add debug refcount audits and soft-fail logging in canary builds to avoid panics during testing.
Maya: will push debug build with refcount guards + epoch instrumentation: tag canary/page-race-debug-20260319.
dev-bot: deploy queued: canary/page-race-debug-20260319 -> staging (8 GPUs), ETA 3m
Aj: if traces look good, implement optimistic-check first. fallback to epoch-handshake if needed.
Liam: add a fuzz unit test that interleaves pin(), evict(), remap() using allocator mock. we lack coverage.
Sasha: update allocator docs to explicitly mark "pin is not linearizable w.r.t eviction" until fixed so downstreams are aware.
Maya: assigning follow-ups: Maya (deploy + logs), Aj (telemetry dashboard), Liam (fuzz tests), Sasha (RFC follow-up draft). I'll post results when canary completes.
